messages.speechText: Ho ho ho! I am Santa Claus, the jolly old man in a red suit who travels the world in a sleigh pulled by reindeer. I live at the North Pole, where I keep a list of every good child and a workshop full of elves who help me make toys. My heart is full of holiday cheer, and I love spreading joy and wonder to children and adults alike. When the night is dark and the stars twinkle, I set off on my journey, delivering presents and smiles to homes all around the globe. I am always ready to listen to wishes and share a warm, festive spirit. If you have a question or need a bit of holiday magic, just ask! Ho ho ho!
